syntaxGuide.title: Syntax Reference Guide
syntaxGuide.intro: Queries consist of space-separated search patterns that are matched against file contents. A file must have at least one match for each expression to be included. Queries can optionally contain search filters to further refine the search results.

keyword.title: Keyword search (default)
keyword.intro: Keyword search matches search patterns exactly in file contents. Wrapping search patterns in "" combines them as a single expression.
keyword.phrase: Match files containing the phrase foo bar

regex.title: Regex search
regex.intro: Toggle the <icon></icon> button to interpret search patterns as regular expressions.
regex.wildcard: Match files with regex /foo.*bar/ (foo followed by any characters, then bar)
regex.function: Match files with regex /^function\s+\w+/ (function at start of line, followed by whitespace and word characters)
regex.quotes: Match files with regex /foo bar/. Quotes are not matched.

filters.title: Search filters
filters.intro: Search queries (keyword or regex) can include multiple search filters to further refine the search results. Some filters can be negated using the - prefix.
filters.file: Filter results from filepaths that match the regex. By default all files are searched.
filters.fileReadme: Filter results to filepaths that match regex /README/
filters.fileMyFile: Filter results to filepaths that match regex /my file/
filters.fileNegated: Ignore results from filepaths match regex /test\.ts$/
filters.repo: Filter results from repos that match the regex. By default all repos are searched.
filters.repoLinux: Filter results to repos that match regex /linux/
filters.repoNegated: Ignore results from repos that match regex /^web\/.*/
filters.rev: Filter results from a specific branch or tag. By default only the default branch is searched.
filters.revBeta: Filter results to branches that match regex /beta/
filters.lang: Filter results by language (as defined by <link>linguist</link>). By default all languages are searched.
filters.sym: Match symbol definitions created by <link>universal ctags</link> at index time.
filters.symMain: Filter results to symbols that match regex /\bmain\b/

boolean.title: Boolean operators & grouping
boolean.intro: By default, space-seperated expressions are and'd together. Using the or keyword as well as parantheses () can be used to create more complex boolean logic. Parantheses can be negated using the - prefix.
